description: Lists which moving-labor service types are supported in a 5-digit US ZIP code: labor-only (standard), labor-only (elite, background-checked crews), movers + truck (full service), and packing (an add-on to a labor booking). Use this to answer 'what moving service types do you have in my area'. This is a coverage/catalog answer (what is supported here), not a date-specific availability check -- for providers available on a given date use list_service_providers.

zipCode.description: The 5-digit US ZIP code to check supported service types for

name: get_supported_service_types
